AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING OF NOVEMBER 4, 2024 OF
THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE OF
THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes preparation.
The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Committee meetings.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the Secretary to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the Secretary at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Committee meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's recommended measures to promote social distancing. All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85205231778
Zoom Meeting ID: 852 0523 1778
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 852 0523 1778#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Please submit your correspondence in writing to pvefinance@pvestates.org. Comments received by NOON on Friday December 10, 2021 will be included with the posted agenda. Additional comments received by NOON on Wednesday, December 15, 2021 will be forwarded to the Members and posted online as late correspondence. All correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda by simply utilizing the "Raise Hand" feature during the item under consideration. When called upon to speak please state your name for the record. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Finance Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.

NEW BUSINESS
